raw_segments.text: Looky here, he went on, taking my watch out of my pocket and turning towards him a ring
on my finger while I recoiled from his touch as if he had been a snake.
A gold un and a beauty, that's a gentleman's, I hope.
A diamond all set round with rubies, that's a gentleman's, I hope.
Look at your linen, fine and beautiful.
Look at your clothes, better ain't to be got.
And your books, too, turning his eyes round the room, mounting up on their shelves by hundreds.
And you read him, don't you?
I see you'd been a reading of him when I come in.
Ha, ha, ha, you shall read him to me, dear boy.
And if they're in foreign languages, what, I don't understand, I shall be just as proud as if I did.
